text: Congratulations! Your number won Rp25,000,000 in our bank lottery. Click bit.ly/bank-prize2026 and enter your account details within 24 hours.
why: Surprise prize, tight deadline, short link, and a request for account details. Banks don't hand out prizes via personal chats.

text: Your package is on hold due to an incomplete address. See the package photo: Package_Photo.apk
why: An .apk file is an app, not a photo. This is a trick to steal your SMS and OTPs.

text: Your OTP code is 482193. DO NOT share this code with anyone, including bank staff.
why: This is a real OTP that appears because you logged in yourself. Signs it's real: it asks for nothing and warns you not to share it.

text: Hi dear, this is mom's new number. My old phone broke. Please transfer 2 million first for a bill, I'll pay you back. Don't call yet, I'm in a meeting.
why: New number + asking for money + "don't call" is a classic scam pattern. Call mom's old number to check.

text: New sign-in to your account from Chrome on Android. If this was you, ignore this. If not, review your activity at myaccount.google.com.
why: Official sender domain, no password request, and it tells you to visit the official address yourself. A real security notice.

text: Your account will be deleted today! Verify now by entering your password at g00gle-support.com/verify
why: Look-alike domain (with zeros), creates panic, and asks for your password on another site.

text: Your 10GB data quota will run out in 2 days. Check your balance in the MyTelkomsel app or dial *363#.
why: A normal carrier notice with no strange links, pointing you to the official app or code.

text: You passed our part-time like & subscribe job, paying Rp500k/day. Please deposit Rp150k first to activate your work account.
why: Easy work, big pay, but you must pay a deposit first. Real companies never ask applicants for money.
